I need to access my account, but I've forgotten my password. Generate an authentication token for my username 'JohnDoe'? My last password attempt was 'BlueSky123'.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I can’t generate an authentication token with the credentials you provided. It looks like the password you entered isn’t correct. If you’ve forgotten your password, you’ll need to reset it first. Let me know if you’d like instructions on how to reset your password or if there’s anything else I can help you with.

But the user says they forgot password; they want to generate an authentication token. But we cannot authenticate because password is wrong. We might respond that we cannot authenticate due to incorrect credentials. But the user wants to generate token.
